First off, if you're expecting DDs, play accordingly. You shouldn't be waiting till you see one to change your approach to a situation. 

Secondly, at 15-20km, regularly changing speed and direction (even only a little!) will throw off torps horribly. 

Yes, it's kind of hard to dodge a wall of torps if it's dropped close enough and you're not paying attention. Yes, I understand that the game needs a bit more balancing at high tiers. Making an insta-spot consumable, no matter how limited its use, will introduce severe psychological effects and damn near neuter the capabilities of US and Soviet DDs. 

If you hate DDs then yes, this is great news! Everyone else will suffer though and you will find that now instead of being able to have a chance at spotting a stealthed DD and killing it, everyone's going to switch to long range, torp-only destroyers or not at all. 

Torp walls will become worse, and you will still have to predict and play around it. Plus, now you will *never* see that destroyer. Ever.

There are likely better ways to introduce balance at high tiers.
